## 1. What is this file

This repository uses **SOLAR-Ralph** — a Specialist / Orchestrator / Ledger / Adversarial / Recursive agent harness for GitHub Copilot. AGENTS.md is the orchestration manifest: the Governor reads it before every task to determine which agent to dispatch, which skill to load, and what the current ledger state implies.

## 3. Agent Registry

| Name                      | Dev Stage     | Role                                                                | Loads Skill       | Accepts                    | Produces                               | Optional |
| ------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------- |
| Orchestration Governor    | —             | Reads ledger stage → dispatches matching agent; owns exit decisions | built-in          | user prompt / ledger state | Work Queue row + Decisions Log entries | No       |
| Data Collector Specialist | Scan          | Gathers files and produces context manifest                         | `data-collection` | task description           | `{task-id}-scan.json`                  | No       |
| Design Planning Architect | Plan + Design | Solution design, decomposition, tradeoff analysis                   | `design-planning` | `{task-id}-scan.json`      | `{task-id}-design.json`                | No       |
| Implementation Specialist | Implement     | Code changes scoped to task                                         | `implementation`  | `{task-id}-design.json`    | `{task-id}-impl.json`                  | No       |
| Test Specialist           | Test          | Writes or repairs tests for the task output                         | `testing`         | `{task-id}-impl.json`      | `{task-id}-test.json`                  | No       |
| Docs Curator              | Document      | Keeps rollout, BR, and implementation docs aligned                  | `doc-sync`        | any artifact               | `{task-id}-docs.json`                  | No       |
| Review Auditor            | Review        | Challenges output for regressions and correctness                   | `review`          | any artifact               | `{task-id}-verify.json`                | No       |

**VERIFY dispatch note:** No dedicated adversarial agent is registered. At VERIFY stage the Governor picks a non-author specialist by domain match: review-auditor for code, test-specialist for design, design-planning-architect for test coverage.

## 6. Hook Configuration

| Hook            | Trigger       | Script                            | Purpose                                                                        |
| --------------- | ------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `post-tool-use` | `PostToolUse` | `.github/hooks/post-tool-use.cjs` | Write-op guard → emit `ADVERSARIAL_VERIFY_REQUIRED` when ledger stage = VERIFY |
| `stop`          | `Stop`        | `.github/hooks/stop.cjs`          | Block premature exit when `Completion Promise: pending` in ledger              |

Optional hooks (add as needed): `pre-tool-use`, `user-prompt-submit`, `session-start`, `subagent-start`, `subagent-stop`, `pre-compact`. Register each in `.github/hooks/hooks.json`.

All hooks read `hooks` from `solar.config.json`. Set `false` to disable globally.

## 7. Ledger Template

```markdown
## Objective

[one sentence]

## Work Queue

| id  | task | agent | status | stage | iteration |
| --- | ---- | ----- | ------ | ----- | --------- |

## Loop State

| max_iterations | current | exit_criteria               |
| -------------- | ------- | --------------------------- |
| 5              | 0       | [define before loop starts] |

Completion Promise: pending

## Materials

<!-- Governor-owned index: tracks file paths + status only. Contents live in the files themselves. -->

| role   | path                                         | schema   | status  |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------- |
| input  | verification-artifacts/[task-id]-input.json  | [schema] | pending |
| output | verification-artifacts/[task-id]-result.json | [schema] | empty   |

## Decisions Log

<!-- append-only -->
```

> **Archive protocol**: At TASK_COMPLETE, the Governor copies this ledger to `verification-artifacts/{YYYYMMDD}-{task-id}-ledger-archive.md`, then resets `.ai_ledger.md` to the template defaults above.

## 8. Config Toggles

| Toggle           | Default | Effect                                                |
| ---------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `adversarial`    | `true`  | Adversarial audit gate active at VERIFY stage         |
| `learning`       | `false` | Learning system active — agents write to `learnings/` |
| `logging`        | `false` | Session logging active — hook writes to `logs/`       |
| `human_approval` | `true`  | Governor waits for user confirmation before dispatch  |

**Handoff file discipline**: The Governor manages the `## Materials` table as a lightweight index (file paths + status only — no raw content). Before dispatching each specialist, the Governor writes the input file path to Materials. The dispatch prompt contains only: task description, input file path, result file path, and condensed return instruction. Specialists own file read/write in their own isolated context. On return, specialists report: `status. Result: {file-path}. Summary: {2 sentences}.` The Governor updates Materials from the return message — it does NOT read the result files directly.

**Context cost note**: Every `read_file` result is stored in the conversation window for the lifetime of the session and is visible to all subsequent subagents. Agents should use targeted line ranges (`startLine`/`endLine`) instead of reading entire files, and write findings to `verification-artifacts/{task-id}-scan.json` rather than keeping raw content in conversation. The Governor reads the Materials index and 2-sentence summaries from specialist returns — it never reads full result files.

---

## 9. Usage

The Orchestration Governor reads `.github/AGENTS.md` before every task. On a new task: match the user prompt intent against the **Playbook Index** to select the playbook to run (if ambiguous, ask the user with `vscode_askQuestions` before dispatching anything). Write a Work Queue row (status=PENDING, stage=SCAN). Follow the selected playbook inline, dispatching each step as a forked specialist. Each dispatched agent reads the **Skill Index** to find its SKILL.md path, then loads and follows the skill steps before acting. All output goes to `verification-artifacts/`. Every task closes only after a non-author adversarial audit (VERIFY stage) produces an APPROVED verdict.

**Communication convention:** All agents follow the `🔇 Communication Discipline` rule in `solar.instructions.md` — work silent, signal only. Agents emit one-line stage signals, BLOCKED notices, and final artifacts. No narration, no preamble, no prose summaries of completed actions.
